title: Arnow Test for Catecholate-Type Siderophores
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.icpcavn
materials: For a standard curve, use DHBA (dihydroxybenzoic acid)

steps.title: Dilute sample to 1 mL
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the siderophore sample into a tube and bring the volume to 1 mL with Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Add reagents sequentially
steps.instruction: Add each reagent to the diluted sample and mix thoroughly as described.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of reagent 1 (0.5 N HCl) and mix.
Add 1 mL of reagent 2 (10 g NaNO₂ and 10 g NaMO dissolved in 10 mL ultrapure Chelex‑100‑treated water) and mix. Omit this addition for a blank sample.
Add 1 mL of reagent 3 (1 M NaOH) and mix.
Add 1 mL of Milli‑Q water and mix.

steps.title: Incubate and measure
steps.instruction: Allow the reaction to develop for 10–40 min at room temperature, then measure absorbance at 500 nm using a spectrophotometer.
